value: meat matures to 600-700 g in four months, suited to single-portion or spit roasting
included in the CO.VA. regional conservation project alongside the Padovana and other Veneto breeds
some critics argue its traits are too variable to count as a settled breed

history_summary.value: The Pepoi is a traditional small farmhouse chicken from north-eastern Italy, particularly Friuli-Venezia Giulia and the Veneto, and is one of only a few true bantam breeds native to Italy. It remains unrecognised as an official breed but is included in a regional conservation project because of its low numbers.
